title: Data Trees & Details
objective: Detail the facade: run mullions up the tower and cut its skin into panels.
learn: Data trees: one branch per floor, Flip Matrix to regroup, per-branch operations for details.

nodes.need: a component that places the same number of points on every floor
nodes.hint: Curve › Division. A fixed count of equal parts.
nodes.correct: Divide Curve runs once per floor curve, so its output is a data tree: one branch per floor, each holding N points — {0;0}, {0;1}, {0;2} …

wrong.divideLength: Divide Length uses a fixed spacing, so floors of different size would get different counts — the mullions wouldn't line up.
wrong.shatter: Shatter cuts curves into pieces but doesn't give you points.
wrong.*: This slot needs a component that places the same number of points on every floor.

nodes.stage: Place the same number of points on every floor. The result is a data tree: one branch per floor.

nodes.need: a component that regroups the points by position instead of by floor
nodes.correct: Flip Matrix swaps rows and columns of the tree: instead of one branch per floor, you get one branch per point position — every point that sits above each other is now grouped together.

wrong.flatten: Flatten throws all points into one list — you lose the grouping you need for vertical lines.
wrong.graft: Graft puts every single point on its own branch; you'd get points, not columns.
wrong.reverseList: Reverse List just flips the order inside each floor.
wrong.*: This slot needs a component that regroups the points by position instead of by floor.

nodes.stage: Regroup the points so each branch holds one column: the same position on every floor.

nodes.need: a component that draws a curve through each column of points
nodes.hint: Curve › Spline. Runs once per branch.
nodes.correct: Interpolate runs once per branch, so each column of points becomes one mullion curve climbing and twisting with the tower.

wrong.line: Line joins pairs of points — you'd get short segments, not continuous mullions.
wrong.loft: Loft makes surfaces, not mullion lines.
wrong.*: This slot needs a component that draws a curve through each column of points.

nodes.stage: Draw a curve through each column. The mullions climb and twist with the tower.

nodes.need: a component that gives each mullion curve real thickness
nodes.hint: Surface › Freeform. A radius around a rail curve.
nodes.correct: Pipe wraps a round profile around each curve — the mullions become solid detail elements.

wrong.extrude: Extrude pushes a curve along a vector into a ribbon, not a round member.
wrong.offset: Offset copies the curve; it stays thin.
wrong.boundary: Boundary Surfaces fills closed flat outlines.
wrong.*: This slot needs a component that gives each mullion curve real thickness.

check.prompt: The Mullions slider should drive which input of Divide Curve?
check.hint: C = curve, N = count, K = split at kinks.
check.correct: N is the number of segments per floor — the number of mullions around the tower.

wrong.C: C is the curve; the floors are already connected.
wrong.K: K is a True/False kink switch.

check.prompt: Which OUTPUT of Divide Curve should feed Flip Matrix?
check.hint: The mullions pass through locations on each floor.
check.correct: P carries the division points — the locations the mullions pass through.

wrong.T: T carries tangent vectors — directions, not locations.
wrong.t: t carries curve parameters — numbers, not points.
